intro: Papua New Guinea exports gas, gold, copper, palm oil and coffee.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: A big liquefied gas project sends gas to Asia. Gold and copper come from mines like Ok Tedi and Lihir. Most people farm for food.

chapters.title: Forests
text: Large rainforests are under pressure from logging.

cardGroups.title: Made in Papua New Guinea
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Papua New Guinea makes and sells to the world.
